title: Important dates | Blocks, carry-forward and outward journey
caution: Regular-block carry-forward is conditional. Fresh-recruit annual occasions have different rules.
text: Rules eight and nine, and July twenty twenty five FAQ thirteen to eighteen. Regular four-year block January one, twenty twenty six से December thirty one, twenty twenty nine है. Two-year sub-blocks twenty twenty six to twenty seven और twenty twenty eight to twenty nine हैं. Example, Regular employee की twenty twenty six journey में सही block debit करो, twenty twenty two to twenty five को current मत बोलो. Rule ten, carry-forward, and FAQ sixteen to eighteen. Eligible unused previous-block LTC, next block के first year में ली जा सकती है. Twenty twenty six grace year है. Hometown-entitled employee की All India carry-forward पर second sub-block वाली condition भी है. Example, Unused twenty twenty four to twenty five occasion हो, तो eligibility और previous usage check करके twenty twenty six में charge करो. Rule nine, outward journey; fresh-recruit FAQ sixty four to sixty nine. Block counting में outward journey की start date देखो, return की नहीं. Fresh-recruit annual LTC पर regular one-year carry-forward नहीं लगता. Example, Eligible grace-year journey December thirty one को start, January में return हो, तो सिर्फ return date से wrong block मत लगाओ.

title: Important dates | Booking guidance and claim deadlines
caution: Calendar months are not automatically 30/90/180 days. Relaxation is not an automatic extension.
text: Booking OM dated August twenty nine, twenty twenty two, paragraph one, clause Roman four; Cash circular July sixteen, twenty twenty six. Twenty one days पहले ticket booking encouraged है. Return journey complete होने के बाद, advance लिया था तो one month में claim; advance नहीं था तो three months में claim. Example, दो colleagues same day लौटे, लेकिन एक ने advance लिया था. दोनों की normal claim limit same नहीं है. OM dated December twenty one, twenty twenty three; FAQ thirty five and seventy one. Ministry, Financial Advisor concurrence से limited delayed claims admit कर सकती है. No advance में six months तक; advance में three months तक, full advance plus penal interest one lump sum refund की condition है. Example, Late claim को automatic extension मत समझो. Authority, refund और interest conditions पहले check करो.

text: Rule two, sub rule one, covered categories. ये Rule one, sub rule three के clauses Roman two, Roman three और Roman four के लिए है. Example, State deputationist, contract officer और re employed officer के cases में ये test देखो. Re employment में sub rule three की continuity भी साथ पढ़ो. Rule two, sub rule one, completed service condition. One year की continuous Central Government service complete होनी चाहिए. Example, Neha four year contract sign करके six months बाद trip plan करती है. Long contract, six months को one year नहीं बना देता. Rule two, sub rule one, certification condition. Appropriate administrative authority को required likely service period certify करना है. Example, Employee खुद four years रहने का promise करे, तो वो authority के certificate का substitute नहीं है. Rule two, sub rule one, Hometown duration condition. At least two years की likely Central service joining date से count होगी, trip के बाद two extra years नहीं. Example, Contract January first, twenty twenty six से December thirty first, twenty twenty seven तक है. February twenty twenty seven में one year complete है और joining से total two years हैं. Proper certificate के साथ ये duration condition pass हो सकती है. बाकी LTC conditions भी check होंगी.

text: Rule two, sub rule one, Any Place in India duration condition. At least four years की likely Central service joining date से count होगी. Example, Contract January first, twenty twenty six से December thirty first, twenty twenty nine तक है. February twenty twenty seven में one year complete है और joining से total four years हैं. Four years trip से फिर count नहीं होंगे. ये duration condition है, final LTC approval नहीं. Rule two, sub rule two. Initial one year contract बाद में extend हो, तो total contract duration LTC के लिए देखो. Example, Neha का twenty twenty six वाला contract बिना gap twenty twenty nine तक extend हुआ. सिर्फ first one year letter देखकर reject मत करो. Actual extension order चाहिए. Rule two, sub rule three, immediate re employment and continuity. Retirement के immediately बाद बिना break re employment में old और new service LTC के लिए continuous treat होती है. Example, Retirement October thirty first के end पर और re employment November first से है. Fresh one year clock automatically start मत करो. Gap वाले case में ये special treatment automatically assume नहीं कर सकते.

text: Rule two, sub rule three, provided that condition, also called the proviso. Simple test, retire न होते तो ये LTC मिलती? Continuity, used benefit refill नहीं करती. Example, Sana की relevant All India occasion retirement से पहले use हो चुकी है. Next day re employment same occasion दोबारा नहीं देती. Rule two, sub rule three, official illustration. Already used Any Place in India LTC, same four year block में no break re employment से फिर नहीं मिलती. Example, Official illustration का updated hypothetical लो. Dev ने twenty twenty six to twenty twenty nine की All India occasion August में use की, October में retire हुआ और next day re employed हुआ. Same block में fresh All India occasion नहीं मिलेगी. Rule three, employee coverage. Scope में employee और eligible family आते हैं. Rule three में अलग numbered sub rules नहीं हैं. Example, Eligible employee अकेले trip करता है. Family साथ नहीं है, सिर्फ इस वजह से Rule three उसे reject नहीं करता. Rule three, family coverage, read with Rule four, clause D. Family का legal meaning check करो. Rule four, clause D की full detail next batch में होगी. Example, Spouse और friend साथ travel करते हैं. Friend सिर्फ साथ जाने से eligible LTC family member नहीं बनता.

text: Rule three, cross reference to Rules nine and eleven, and the July first, twenty twenty five FAQ, question six. Employee और eligible family separate groups में अलग time पर travel कर सकते हैं. ये Rule three का नया sub clause नहीं है. Example, Employee June में और eligible family October में travel propose करे, तो separate dates alone rejection का reason नहीं हैं. Person wise block और बाकी conditions check होंगी. September third, twenty twenty five DoPT Guidelines, applicability Note one. Autonomous body officer Central Government में deputation पर आए, तो उस period में temporary Government servant वाला LTC treatment मिलता है. ये Rule one का नया numbered clause नहीं है. Example, Iqbal को सिर्फ autonomous parent body की वजह से reject नहीं करेंगे. Temporary word से हर Rule two certificate automatically infer मत करो. Actual category और deputation terms check करो. September third, twenty twenty five DoPT Guidelines, applicability Note two. Industrial और work charged staff जो regular leave के entitled हैं, वो भी normal conditions पर eligible हैं. Example, Regular leave वाले work charged employee को सिर्फ job title से blanket reject मत करो. First block nineteen sixty to sixty one historical है, आज का travel block नहीं.

text: September third, twenty twenty five DoPT Guidelines, paragraph two. Consolidation में conflict या unclear summary हो, तो relevant governing OM या order check करो. ये Rule two का sub rule नहीं है. Example, Summary की unclear line को नया amendment मत मानो. Actual applicable order की reference लो. Batch one teaching checklist, not a separate legal rule. Category, exclusion, valid exception, special service conditions, old block history और eligible family check करो. Example, Contract officer ये starting checks pass करता है. फिर भी payment से पहले family, leave, block, mode, fare, booking और claim conditions अलग check होंगी. Original Gazette date, detailed Railway pass conditions और complete later order checks अभी open हैं.
